domain: Deterministic vs. Probabilistic Agent Control in Software Engineering Systems
research_question: How do state-of-the-art agent architectures reconcile probabilistic model generation with deterministic verification, fail-closed security invariants, and reproducible task execution?
sub_questions: How are reasoning traces separated from executable action steps and environment observations?
What role do deterministic test suites and environment feedback play in bounding hallucinations?
How do self-reflection and verbal reinforcement mechanisms update agent trajectories without mutating base weights?
What are the observed boundaries where probabilistic inference fails and deterministic tool execution is mandatory?
